Fed & Policy Watch
  • Today's key scheduled U.S. release is October Advance Retail Sales at 8:30 AM ET, alongside other 8:30 AM surveys/data; industrial production follows at 9:15 AM ET. FOMC minutes arrive Wednesday Nov 18 at 2:00 PM ET; these minutes are not a policy decision. Treasury duration supply includes the Nov 18 20-year auction and Nov 19 TIPS auction.
  • Key dates after Thanksgiving: BEA Personal Income and Outlays (PCE) on Dec 2 at 8:30 AM ET, Employment Situation Dec 4 at 8:30 AM, FOMC decision Dec 9 at 2:00 PM with press conference at 2:30 PM, CPI Dec 10 at 8:30 AM, and PPI Dec 15 at 8:30 AM. CPI and PPI are distinct releases.
  • Funding/financial conditions: SOFR 3.90% effective Nov 13; NFCI -0.462 for week ending Nov 6; MOVE 101.28 on Nov 16; 10-year Treasury 5.12% on Nov 16. These SOFR/NFCI observations are lagged, not live funding measures. Chicago Fed scheduled its next NFCI release for Nov 18 at 8:30 AM ET.
  • Energy schedule: EIA petroleum report Wed Nov 18 at 10:30 AM and natural gas storage Thu Nov 19 at 10:30 AM; the natural gas report is shifted to Wed Nov 25 at noon for Thanksgiving.
Omissions and Watch
  • Date/event conflict check: the New York Fed November calendar places Personal Income and the PCE Deflator on Nov 25 at 8:30 AM, while the direct BEA schedule places October Personal Income and Outlays on Dec 2 at 8:30 AM; the New York Fed December calendar also lists it on Dec 2. Followed BEA's direct schedule and listed Dec 2, not Nov 25; the calendar disagreement is flagged here. BEA separately confirms Q3 GDP second release Nov 25 at 8:30 AM.
  • NAR's official page confirms Pending Home Sales release Nov 18 at 10:00 AM ET but contains conflicting September-versus-October period text. The period is therefore shown as not stated. NY Fed and Census calendars agree on Nov 17 retail/inventories and Nov 18 housing starts; New York Fed provides the date/time for the other listed national and regional releases. Periods not explicitly established by the relevant source are not inferred.
  • bls.gov was not requested; BLS date/time entries (including imports/exports, claims, Employment Situation, CPI and PPI) were verified on the New York Fed Economic Indicators Calendar. No CPI or PPI appears in the checked Nov 17-25 calendar window; the December CPI and PPI are listed separately. The New York Fed calendar is subject to change.
  • Selected events, not exhaustive. Fed statistical rows are selected by relevance (H.4.1 and H.8); daily Board statistical series and other releases are not exhaustively reproduced. Treasury rows show only securities verified from TreasuryDirect and their competitive bid close times. Chicago Fed CFNAI on Nov 23 is date-only because its release calendar supplies no time. No elapsed release is listed.
  • Energy schedule verified at EIA; the natural gas Nov 25 date/time is a Thanksgiving exception. Other verified liquidity and market-structure watch items are the Nov 18 NFCI release and Treasury auctions above. No verified unscheduled policy/geopolitical item emerged from the sources checked; this was not a full headline-risk review.
  • Classifier provisional unmatched items are flagged Medium above and retained as provisional (including imports/exports, regional indicators, claims, Industrial Production, SPF, NFCI and CFNAI); no impact overrides. Primary sources checked: New York Fed November/December calendars and SOFR API; Federal Reserve Board November/December calendars, FOMC calendars and H.4.1; Census; BEA; NAR; EIA petroleum/natural-gas schedules; TreasuryDirect; U.S. Treasury yields; Chicago Fed NFCI data and release calendar; Philadelphia Fed; Conference Board; University of Michigan. Snapshot uses single-source Yahoo Finance quotes.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Monday's SPY close fell 1.91%, VIX rose to 22.91 and MOVE to 101.28, while the 10-year yield eased 3 bp to 5.12%. ES is nearly unchanged in thin overnight trade versus Monday's completed bar. Retail sales and other 8:30 AM releases are the next catalyst; then monitor Wednesday FOMC minutes, duration supply and EIA data. Expect event-sensitive two-way risk; confirm with rates, breadth and depth rather than extrapolating the overnight quote. Scenario framing only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if retail data or Fed communication materially reprices yields, volatility broadens around energy or Treasury supply, or ES price action lacks confirmation from breadth, rates or depth. No unsupported levels or targets supplied. Refresh quotes and verify intended contract specifications before execution.
